shots.name: RW-09-inn-common-room
shots.note: The Sleeping Giant Inn's common room from its own door's arrival, yaw turned to 335 so the fire pit falls in the lower centre-right as the reference has it, with the room's posts, the gallery band of small windows and the bar across the frame. Moved 110 nearer the pit than the file's pose. Confidence: close - the pit, its surround and the room's gallery are in the reference's places; the reference's two seated NPCs have no counterpart (the engine has no NPCs) and its pit rim fills more of the frame. Pose set by hand in the engine (2026-09-24).

shots.name: RW-10-trader-shop-floor
shots.note: Inside the Riverwood Trader, 260 north-west of the shop's fire, looking north-east: the fire and its stone surround at the left, the counter across the right, the hanging goods and the shelf on the back wall. Moved ~180 nearer the fire than the file's pose, which put the fireplace too small and too central. Confidence: close - the fire left and the counter right are the reference's arrangement; the reference stands closer again and its fire's stone surround fills the left third. Pose set by hand in the engine (2026-09-24).
